#116 Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: #138 Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:

Subject 1 — He Jin (何进), the sole visible subject, a single continuous identity across Picture 1 and Picture 2: consistent facial features, age, hair and beard, build, layered late Eastern Han period official garments, headwear, belt and accessories, rendered in the same photorealistic historical cinematic style. No second person is visible; no messenger, attendant, guard, human shadow or reflected figure may appear at any time.

frame_definitions:

<Picture 1> is the authoritative beginning state: He Jin alone in the 省中 council area, calm natural side light, dark recessed architecture behind him, holding the unfolded secret letter of Tang Zhou in both hands, mid-shot from his left-front side, eyes fixed on the text in solemn concentration.

<Picture 2> is the authoritative ending state: He Jin has just finished reading the letter, lifts his eyes toward the off-screen exit on the right side of the frame, with the letter now folded and gathered in his hand; the camera has pushed from medium close-up to a facial close-up; his gaze is cold and resolute, poised to act.

The video must transition chronologically from Picture 1 to Picture 2 and stop at Picture 2's state.

summary:

A single contained transition: He Jin finishes reading the secret letter, raises his gaze to the unseen exit on the right, gathers the letter in his hand, while the camera slowly pushes from medium close-up to a facial close-up — ending on his cold, decisive, ready-to-act expression, with no speech.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1]
Start precisely at Picture 1: He Jin sits alone in the 省中 council area, calm natural side light on his face and the unfolded letter, dark architectural space behind him; medium close-up from his left-front side; both hands hold the letter, eyes lowered onto the text in solemn concentration.

From this state, he quickly finishes reading the remaining lines, then raises his head and turns his gaze toward the right edge of the frame — the off-screen exit of the building — while his hands fold the letter shut and gather it firmly in hand. His expression shifts from solemn contemplation to a cold, resolute determination, as if about to act. Only He Jin is visible; no second person, messenger, attendant, guard, human shadow or reflection appears. The camera performs a slow, steady push-in from medium close-up to facial close-up, consistent with both frames' composition, no jump cut, no reversal, no new scene.

All characters remain silent throughout the entire clip. No speaking, no dialogue, no whispering, no murmuring, no shouting, no laughter, no human vocalization. Mouths remain naturally closed except for subtle expressions or breathing.

End exactly at Picture 2's state: close-up on He Jin's face, eyes cold and resolute, the letter gathered in his hand, ready to take action — and stop there, with no further action afterward. Photorealistic historical cinematic aesthetic, late Eastern Han period live-action drama style, natural physically plausible lighting, realistic fabric, paper, wood and stone textures, no subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

overall_soundscape:

Subtle paper rustling as he finishes reading and folds the letter; faint fabric movement; quiet ambient room tone of a stone-and-wood hall with minimal distant air. No dialogue, no speech, no human vocalization.
